request_data.content:
Users: id, email, name, created_at
Orders: id, user_id, total_amount, status, created_at
Products: id, name, description, price, stock_quantity
OrderItems: id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price
Reviews: id, user_id, product_id, rating, comment
Categories: id, name, parent_id
ProductCategories: product_id, category_id

metadata.mermaid_code:
erDiagram
    Users ||--o{ Orders : places
    Users ||--o{ Reviews : writes
    Orders ||--o{ OrderItems : contains
    Products ||--o{ OrderItems : appears_in
    Products ||--o{ Reviews : receives
    Products ||--o{ ProductCategories : is_categorized_as
    Categories ||--o{ ProductCategories : contains_product
    Categories }|--o{ Categories : has_parent

    Users {
        VARCHAR(255) id PK
        VARCHAR(255) email
        VARCHAR(255) name
        DATETIME created_at
    }

    Orders {
        VARCHAR(255) id PK
        VARCHAR(255) user_id FK
        DECIMAL(10,2) total_amount
        VARCHAR(50) status
        DATETIME created_at
    }

    Products {
        VARCHAR(255) id PK
        VARCHAR(255) name
        TEXT description
        DECIMAL(10,2) price
        INT stock_quantity
    }

    OrderItems {
        VARCHAR(255) id PK
        VARCHAR(255) order_id FK
        VARCHAR(255) product_id FK
        INT quantity
        DECIMAL(10,2) unit_price
    }

    Reviews {
        VARCHAR(255) id PK
        VARCHAR(255) user_id FK
        VARCHAR(255) product_id FK
        INT rating
        TEXT comment
    }

    Categories {
        VARCHAR(255) id PK
        VARCHAR(255) name
        VARCHAR(255) parent_id FK
    }

    ProductCategories {
        VARCHAR(255) product_id PK,FK
        VARCHAR(255) category_id PK,FK
    }
